This article describes what to do when you can't hear sound in Firefox.
*To allow autoplay of media with sound, see [[Allow or block media autoplay in Firefox]].

{for win}
__TOC__

= Check the Volume Mixer =
# Open Firefox and play content that should play sound, such as this [http://youtu.be/LtOGa5M8AuU Firefox video].
# {for win7,win8}Click{/for}{for win10,win11}Right-click{/for} the volume icon in the Windows taskbar.
# Click {for win7,win8}'''Mixer'''{/for}{for win10,win11}'''Open Volume Mixer'''{/for}. The Volume Mixer window will appear.
# Make sure the slider for ''Mozilla Firefox'' is not muted or at the bottom.<!-- Volume Mixer while playing Flash audio content on Windows 7 in Firefox 82. Test page: http://comp.cast.org/audiotest/ -->
;{for win7}[[Image:VolumeMixer-Win7]]{/for}{for win8,win10,win11}[[Image:Win10 Volume Mixer]]{/for}

= Check your audio device =
Make sure that the audio device (such as speakers or headphones) are turned on and connected to the computer properly. 

= Other solutions =
Check out whether other applications on your computer can play sounds. If they can't:
* Follow Microsoft's [https://support.microsoft.com/en-ca/help/4026994/windows-fix-sound-problems Fix sound problems] tutorial.
If Firefox is the only application that you can't hear sound in:
* Try the solutions in [[Video or audio does not play]].
{/for}
{for mac}
Make sure other applications on your computer can play sounds. If Firefox is the only application that you can't hear sounds in:
* Try the solutions in [[Video or audio does not play]].
If no application can play sounds:
* See Apple's [http://support.apple.com/kb/ts1574 Troubleshooting issues with no audio from built-in speakers on Macs].
* If you have an external audio device, check whether it's turned on and connected properly.
{/for}
{for linux}
Make sure other applications on your computer can play sounds. If Firefox is the only application that doesn't play sounds:
* Try the solutions in [[Video or audio does not play]].
If you can't hear sounds in any other applications:
* Make sure that the audio device (such as speakers or headphones) are turned on and connected to the computer properly.
{/for}
